name: Mortal Kombat: Armageddon — Johnny Cage Biography
notes: Official in-game Johnny Cage biography reproduced by Mortal Kombat Warehouse, which is used here as preservation/access infrastructure rather than canonical authority. Johnny describes Shinnok as someone his side had defeated years earlier and later states that Shinnok was back. This directly confirms a prior Original-continuity defeat of Shinnok. The source does not itself label that earlier defeat as a specific Mortal Kombat 4 scene, identify Liu Kang as the individual victor, provide a complete victor roster or exact battle location, or establish a direct causal bridge from the renewed MK4 war to the defeat.
